senses.definition: n.pr.loc. in Judah Jos 15:41, near Beth Horon Jos 10:10, and Libnah v 29, where was a cave v 16, 17, cf. v 21, captured by Joshua v 28, with a king v 28; 12:16. 𝔊 Μακηδα. Site dubious, WarrenSurvey Mem. ii. 411 ff., 427 comp. El-mughâr, c. 2¾ miles SW. from Ekron.
